description: Select the slides that best fit the current presentation request. Respect each slide inclusion policy, placement metadata, and every slide-selection group rule.

selection_group_instructions.purpose: Selection groups constrain which slides may be returned together. Return only selected_slides; do not return group decisions or group metadata.

type_descriptions.choice: An active choice group selects exactly one direct member. An optional root choice may select no members.
type_descriptions.bundle: An active bundle group selects every direct member recursively. An inactive bundle selects none of them.

rules: Only root groups carry inclusion_policy; nested groups are activated by their parent.
Group members are direct slide_id or group_id references.
A valid final selection must satisfy every active choice and bundle recursively.
A normalized single-slide root is treated as a standalone slide rather than a group.
